title: 6 Manifestation Habits That Actually Work
one_liner: Six daily practices for staying in a manifestation mindset by treating life like a game you're meant to win.
key_points: Method act before every interaction: ask how you'd show up if success was already guaranteed, then embody that
Genuine happiness for others and avoiding envy are key to becoming magnetic and attracting luck
